description: ESC firmware implements vehicle stability control via integrated sensor fusion, brake intervention, and engine torque reduction. Secure coding guidelines focus on memory safety (sensor buffer handling), integer safety (torque/pressure calculations), cryptographic authentication of sensor inputs (IPMs, IPC), and secure logging of control decisions and faults. CAL-C (moderate risk of misuse) requires Mandatory and Required rules without exception; Advisory rules may be deviated with justification. All rules are subject to static analysis baseline policy and deviation tracking.
